title: a native pin over a graph that reaches no TypeScript requirement and no host dependence adds no diagnostic and the program compiles and runs
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, 'Native Pin': 'A native pin MUST be a checked assertion over the complete transitive graph. Compilation MUST fail if any reachable operation or provider requires TypeScript.' The positive half of that sentence: a graph with no reachable TypeScript requirement satisfies the assertion, so the pin is silent. docs/DECISIONS.md leaves the spelling Open; this area proposes the imported-intrinsic form `native(fn)` from "smithers:native", the shape the same ledger locks for comptime ('Comptime is not a language keyword ... The compiler recognizes the resolved binding rather than its local spelling').
